result.summary: Wrote docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-017.md covering all 6 acceptance criteria plus two gap cases not named by any AC but structurally required (AC-cover: photo vs. text branch selection; AC-catalog: i18n key parity across types.ts/ru.ts/en.ts and /events registration in index.ts). Scope test: real user-visible surface (event card rendering, /events list), full Steps 3b/4 apply. Read docs/agents/design/REQ-017.md's 6 ACs, the real implementation (apps/bot/src/domain/event.ts, apps/bot/src/handlers/{event,start}.ts, apps/bot/src/i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.ts), and BACKEND-DEV's existing unit tests (apps/bot/src/domain/event.test.ts, apps/bot/src/i18n/formatTimeInTimezone.test.ts, 101/101 passing) before designing. Independence: this spec does not restate the existing pure-function unit tests as its own evidence -- it names the exact existing test(s) to re-run for AC2/AC5 (formatDateTimeInTimezone's TZ-independence, buildEventCardContent's agenda rendering) and then adds LIVE, DB-integration coverage of what those unit tests structurally cannot reach: getEventByIdWithChapterTimezone's and listUpcomingPublishedEvents's actual JOIN/filter behavior, the /events handler's own composition, the deep-link handler's isFinished gating against real draft/cancelled/finished rows, the sendPhoto-vs-sendMessage branch, and i18n/index.ts wiring -- none of which BACKEND-DEV's unit tests exercise at all (they call domain functions directly with hand-built objects, never through a real query or a real dispatched command). Gaps found in BACKEND-DEV's own test coverage: (1) zero test of the two new DB queries (getEventByIdWithChapterTimezone, listUpcomingPublishedEvents) against a real database -- a wrong JOIN condition or filter bug would pass every existing unit test; (2) zero test of makeEventsListHandler's composition (empty state, no-chapter case, per-row seats computation, row string format); (3) zero test of the isFinished gate actually wired into resolveEventDeepLink against a live finished-but-published row -- this is the exact defect class design SS5/6.4(c) says REQ-016 left open, and no unit test targets the integration point where it's closed; (4) zero test of the sendPhoto/cover_file_id branch in start.ts; (5) zero test confirming ru.ts/en.ts actually define all 11 events.* keys types.ts declares (a satisfies-Catalog compile check exists but this spec independently re-verifies it against the real files rather than trusting the build). AC1 (map links), AC2 (chapter TZ, live mismatched-process-TZ check), AC3 (seatsLeft live + no-write proof via updated_at), AC4 (grep-based no-persisted-field check), AC5 (agenda live JSONB round-trip, out-of-order stored array), AC6 (draft/cancelled/finished exclusion from both /events and deep link, independently re-confirmed per design's own SS4.4 instruction; empty state text + wishlist grep; chapterless-user case) each have >=1 precise, runnable verification case with exact fixture SQL, exact dispatch calls, and exact expected captured/read-back values -- none rely on judgment calls. Every case would fail under the specific wrong implementation it targets (stated explicitly per case).
